hint.title: You’ve used your {{limit}} free hints today.
hint.body: Plus gives you unlimited hints — never get stuck again — and keeps the whole app ad free.

undo.title: You’ve reached your daily undo limit!
undo.body: You get {{limit}} free undos per day. The limit resets tomorrow, or subscribe for unlimited undos.

collectionLocked.title: This puzzle is part of the Plus collection.
collectionLocked.body: Plus unlocks every puzzle in every month’s pack, and keeps the whole app ad free.

themeColor.title: This theme is exclusive to Plus.
themeColor.body: Upgrade to unlock all beautiful theme colors and personalise your unblock race experience.

removeMember.title: Removing members from your party is a premium feature!
removeMember.body: Subscribe to unlock advanced party management features including member removal.

multipleParties.title: Multiple racing teams is a premium feature!
multipleParties.body: Free users can have one team. Subscribe to create and join unlimited teams for family, friends, and more.

partyMaxSize.title: Large parties is a premium feature!
partyMaxSize.body: Subscribe to unlock advanced party management features including large parties.

adFree.title: Always ad free
adFree.description: No ads, ever — just you and the puzzles

hints.title: Unlimited hints
hints.description: Never get stuck — get a hint whenever you need one

monthlyPack.title: Entire monthly pack unlocked, every month
monthlyPack.description: Play every puzzle in every difficulty, no locks

undos.title: Unlimited undos
undos.description: Rewind as many moves as you like

teams.title: Multiple racing teams
teams.description: Host private competitions with friends and family

management.title: Team management
management.description: Create large parties up to 15 people, and remove members from your team.

plusModal.description: Join {{plusName}} for unlimited hints, the entire monthly pack unlocked, and unlimited undos. Challenge friends, climb leaderboards, and keep it ad free.
